capabilities.title: Protocol and browser-client interoperability
capabilities.summary: LiveViewJS implements an older Phoenix protocol surface, but current client compatibility has not been demonstrated.
gaps: Prove joins, events, diffs, heartbeats, reconnects, and errors

capabilities.title: Mount, params, events, messages, connected state, and termination
capabilities.summary: Core lifecycle callbacks exist, but parity and cleanup semantics have not been catalogued against the pinned upstream release.

capabilities.title: Stateful and stateless component composition
capabilities.summary: Live components exist, but update, preload, targeting, composition, and type-safety parity are not verified.

capabilities.title: Diff rendering, comprehensions, and template statics
capabilities.summary: Diff rendering exists, while signed statics and current DOM protocol behavior remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Streams and stream DOM semantics
capabilities.summary: Phoenix-compatible stream operations and DOM semantics are not implemented.
gaps: Implement insert, delete, reset, and refetch semantics
Verify DOM behavior in real browsers

capabilities.title: Async assigns, tasks, streams, and cancellation
capabilities.summary: The current API does not provide the Phoenix async lifecycle or cancellation model.
gaps: Verify disconnect cleanup and failure behavior

capabilities.title: Forms, validation, recovery, debounce, and throttle
capabilities.summary: Form helpers and changesets exist, but current client semantics and recovery behavior are not proven.
gaps: Inventory nested input and recovery semantics
Add browser tests for debounce and throttle

capabilities.title: Upload selection, progress, cancellation, and consumption
capabilities.summary: Upload primitives exist, but storage, limits, security, cleanup, and current-client behavior are not production verified.
gaps: Add browser tests for internal and external uploads

capabilities.title: Patch, redirect, flash, title, history, and reconnect behavior
capabilities.summary: Navigation helpers exist, but the complete current browser-client lifecycle is not documented or tested.
gaps: Test browser history and reconnect behavior

capabilities.title: Client hooks and DOM patch interoperability
capabilities.summary: Hook examples exist, but lifecycle callbacks and DOM patch behavior are not verified against the pinned client.
gaps: Test DOM patch options and cleanup

capabilities.title: Phoenix LiveView JS command parity
capabilities.summary: A subset of JS commands exists, but the pinned upstream command surface and serialization contract are incomplete.
gaps: Inventory all upstream commands and options
Verify composed commands in real browsers

capabilities.title: Server messages, PubSub, and distribution boundaries
capabilities.summary: Single-process PubSub and messages exist, but runtime and distributed semantics are not defined as a parity contract.

capabilities.title: Tracked static assets and static_changed behavior
capabilities.summary: The server does not provide the current tracked-static deployment change contract.

capabilities.title: Production adapters for Node, Bun, and Deno
capabilities.summary: Node and Deno integration code exists, but runtime-neutral production behavior is not proven across all target runtimes.
gaps: Remove Node-only assumptions from shared code
Run identical protocol and browser suites under each runtime

capabilities.title: Typed route params, layouts, and cross-runtime discovery
capabilities.summary: Routing exists, but typed parameters, layouts, and runtime-neutral discovery are incomplete.
gaps: Verify Node, Bun, and Deno behavior

capabilities.title: Black-box browser and cross-runtime verification
capabilities.summary: The project has unit tests but no required real-browser suite spanning Node, Bun, and Deno servers.
gaps: Build the hermetic Playwright reference application

capabilities.title: Idiomatic, strongly typed TypeScript and JavaScript APIs
capabilities.summary: LiveViewJS provides TypeScript APIs, but end-to-end typing and an explicit JavaScript fallback contract are not measured capability by capability.
gaps: Document idiomatic deviations from Phoenix APIs
